verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs clearly support local project creation (`meltano init`), adding extractors/loaders, and testing plugin configuration locally (`meltano config test`), which aligns with local pipeline development before production. However, there is no explicit mention of a 'lightweight' destination (e.g., SQLite, JSONL) commonly used for local testing, nor documentation of a distinct local-vs-production workflow separation. missing for 10: explicit lightweight/test destination examples, documented local-to-production promotion workflow, independent hands-on confirmation of local testing experience.
